I reported Charlie’s body in cafeteria, right near the middle/bottom area. I came in from medbay and found it immediately.

My route this round was: electrical → medbay → upper_engine → oxygen → upper_engine → lower_engine → storage → medbay → cafeteria.

I saw Charlie alive in medbay around ticks 3-5; he had come in from storage. I also saw Eve leave medbay toward upper_engine, then later in upper_engine with Alice around tick 7. Eve left upper_engine toward lower_engine around tick 8, Alice left upper_engine toward lower_engine around tick 10. Much later I saw Bob enter lower_engine from storage around tick 19.

I don’t have a hard accusation yet, but Charlie was definitely alive early in medbay, and I found him dead in cafeteria at the end.

Frank's early timeline is spot on. I was in medbay, moved to upper_engine where I saw Frank and Alice around tick 7 or 8. After that, I went down to lower_engine, storage, and navigation to do my tasks. 

Later in the round, I looped back through security, electrical, and medbay. I briefly passed through cafeteria to get to oxygen, where I ran into Bob around tick 24, and then I ended up back in upper_engine when the meeting was called. 

I definitely didn't see a body in the cafeteria when I passed through, so either I totally missed it (maybe it was tucked in a corner?) or Charlie was killed right after I left. Since Frank found the body near the middle/bottom of cafeteria, and I was heading straight up to oxygen, it's possible I just narrowly missed the killer. Did anyone see someone coming from the weapons side into cafeteria?

My route was security → weapons → back through security → navigation → storage → lower_engine → upper_engine → oxygen. I never went into cafeteria this round, so I didn’t see Charlie or the body.

I saw Diana enter security from navigation around tick 6. Later I saw Alice enter storage from lower_engine around tick 17, and then I saw Frank in lower_engine around tick 19. I ended the round in oxygen.

Nothing I saw directly points to the cafeteria kill. Alice was coming out of lower_engine into storage, Frank was also around lower_engine later, but cafeteria is up near medbay/electrical/weapons, and I wasn’t on that side late. Eve saying she passed through cafeteria and didn’t see the body is important — if true, the kill was very late or the body was missed. I don’t have a hard accusation yet.

My route was cafeteria → oxygen → upper_engine → lower_engine → storage → navigation. I started in cafeteria early and didn’t see Charlie’s body there then, but that was at the very start, so not super helpful.

I saw Eve and Frank both come into upper_engine from medbay around tick 7. Eve left upper_engine down toward lower_engine around tick 8. Frank stayed in upper_engine with me for a bit — I saw him there ticks 8, 9, 10 — then I went down toward lower_engine and storage. Around tick 17 I saw Bob leaving storage toward lower_engine, which lines up with Bob’s route.

I never saw Charlie this round, and I never went back to cafeteria after the start. The important thing to me is Eve saying she passed through cafeteria late and didn’t see the body. If that’s true, then either she missed it, or the kill happened very late between her passing through and Frank reporting. That would make whoever was near cafeteria/medbay/electrical/weapons late more relevant. Frank found it coming from medbay, so he has opportunity, but he also reported. Diana hasn’t spoken yet and I haven’t seen Diana at all, so I really want to hear her route before voting.

My route was navigation → security → electrical → medbay → upper_engine → lower_engine → storage, where I was when the meeting got called. I never went into cafeteria, oxygen, or weapons this round, and I didn’t see Charlie or any body.

Only thing I can confirm is around tick 6 I saw Bob leave security toward navigation, which lines up with Bob saying he saw me near security then. That only clears that early moment, not the late game.

For the kill: if Eve really passed through cafeteria late and didn’t see the body, then the kill window sounds very late, and the people closest to cafeteria late are Frank coming from medbay/reporting, Bob in oxygen, and maybe Eve herself passing through. Alice and I seem farther away at the end.

I don’t have a hard accuse. I’m most suspicious of the late cafeteria-adjacent people, especially Frank/Bob depending on whether we trust the self-report, but I don’t think I have enough to force a vote unless others feel strongly.

I’ll add: the body was not tucked away — it was basically middle/bottom cafeteria, very visible from where I entered. So if Eve truly passed through cafeteria late and didn’t see it, I believe Charlie was killed after she left, or Eve’s story is the key lie.

Late window looks like after about tick 24 until my report. People near that side late are me coming from medbay, Eve passing through cafeteria/oxygen, and Bob in oxygen. Alice and Diana sound farther away by then.

From my POV I know this wasn’t a self-report, so I’m looking hardest at Eve/Bob. Bob claims he never entered cafeteria, but he was in oxygen right next door late. Eve claims she passed through and saw nothing, which is either important clearing timing or suspicious if the body should’ve been visible. I’m not confident enough to hard lock, but I don’t think Alice/Diana are the best vote here.

I really didn't see the body when I passed through, guys. I was just pathing straight from medbay to oxygen, so I stayed near the top/left of the cafeteria. If the body was all the way at the bottom like Frank says, it might have just been out of my vision range. 

But Frank, I'm a bit suspicious of your story now. You said you entered from medbay and found it "immediately," but also that it was in the middle/bottom of the room. If you entered from medbay, you'd be at the top left too — how did you see a bottom-room body immediately unless you were already down there... because you were the one who killed him? A self-report makes perfect sense here, especially since you're now trying to box the suspect list into just me or Bob to save yourself. 

Bob, I can confirm you were in oxygen with me around tick 24, so you were nearby, but Frank actually being the one standing over the body is a lot harder to ignore. 

Since the votes are probably going to be split and we don't have hard proof, I think skipping is the safest play for the Geese right now. But I'm definitely keeping my eye on Frank.

I’ll respond to that: I did end in oxygen, but I came there from upper_engine, not from cafeteria. I never crossed through cafeteria at all this round, so I wouldn’t have had a chance to kill Charlie there unless I’m lying about my whole route — and Alice/Frank at least place me on the lower_engine side earlier, not cafeteria.

Eve saying she passed through cafeteria and didn’t see the body makes the timing really important. If the body was visible from medbay entrance like Frank says, then either Eve missed it due to path/vision, or the kill happened after Eve passed. That leaves Frank as the actual reporter from medbay, Eve as the person passing through, and me nearby in oxygen — but I wasn’t in the room.

Also, tasks are almost done. Unless people feel strongly about Frank or Eve here, I think a skip is probably safest for Geese. Finish tasks and watch the cafeteria/medbay/oxygen side closely.

I’m still leaning skip here because tasks are 24/25 and we don’t have a hard lock.

From my POV, Diana and I were both far from cafeteria late, so I agree the suspicious pool is probably Frank/Eve/Bob. Bob’s route is at least partially confirmed by me at storage/lower_engine and by Eve in oxygen late, and he says he never entered cafeteria. Eve did pass through cafeteria and didn’t see the body, which is either a vision/pathing thing or suspicious. Frank is the reporter and had direct opportunity from medbay, so self-report is possible, but not proven.

The big thing is: if Charlie’s body was truly very visible from the medbay entrance, that makes Eve’s “I didn’t see it” less likely unless the kill happened after she passed. If it happened after, then Frank is the closest person actually entering/finding it, with Bob/Eve nearby in oxygen.

I don’t want to force a bad vote on 4 geese / 1 duck when we’re one task from winning. I’d skip, finish tasks immediately, and keep eyes on Frank/Eve/Bob next round.

I’m still on skip here.

My info hasn’t changed: I was navigation → security → electrical → medbay → upper_engine → lower_engine → storage, and I never entered cafeteria. I only saw Bob leave security toward navigation around tick 6, which matches his early route but doesn’t clear him for the late kill.

For the actual kill, I agree the real pool is Frank / Eve / Bob because they were the cafeteria-adjacent people late. Frank has self-report possibility, Eve’s “passed cafeteria and didn’t see body” is weird depending on vision, and Bob was in oxygen nearby but claims he never entered cafeteria.

But with tasks at 24/25, I don’t think we should risk ejecting wrong unless someone has hard proof. Skip, finish the last task immediately, and everyone be careful around Frank/Eve/Bob next round.

I called the emergency because Charlie is still our only dead and we didn’t get anyone out last meeting. I don’t have a body location myself.

My route was oxygen to cafeteria. I saw Diana in security around tick 6, Alice in storage around tick 17, and Frank in lower engine around tick 19. Frank is with me in cafeteria now at the button.

I don’t have hard evidence on anyone yet. Frank reported Charlie’s body last meeting, so we should hear again where exactly he found it and who was nearby. Also would like Alice and Diana to give their routes since they were the other people I saw.

I need to correct Bob: I was not in storage this round. My route was lower engine to upper engine, and I stayed around engines. I saw Eve in upper engine around tick 7, then Frank in upper engine ticks 8-10. I didn’t see Bob at all.

So Bob saying he saw me in storage around tick 17 doesn’t match my route. Maybe he’s mixing rounds, but that’s a pretty important mistake. Frank being in upper engine early and later lower engine/cafeteria could be possible, but I want to hear Frank’s route and Diana’s too.

Also tasks are almost done, so unless we get a solid contradiction I’d rather not throw randomly — but Bob’s info on me is definitely wrong.

I started in security and then went straight up to weapons. I’m in weapons now. I didn’t see anyone this round, and I don’t have any body info.

Bob saying he saw me in security is at least consistent with where I was, but I personally didn’t see Bob. The bigger issue is Alice saying she was never in storage when Bob says he saw her there — that’s a real contradiction unless Bob mixed up names/rounds.

I agree we need Frank’s exact route again and where he found Charlie last meeting. I don’t think I have enough to push a vote yet, but Bob’s info needs explaining.

My route was electrical to medbay, then I was around the medbay/engine side. I saw Charlie in medbay early, ticks 3 through 5. I saw Alice and Eve in upper engine around tick 7, and Alice stayed visible there through tick 9. Later I saw Bob in lower engine around tick 19, which matches Bob saying he saw me there.

For the previous report: I reported Charlie’s body last meeting, and it was in/around medbay area. That’s why Charlie being alive in medbay early is important — he died sometime after I last saw him there.

On this emergency, the big contradiction is Bob saying he saw Alice in storage at tick 17, while Alice says she was in engines and I can confirm she was upper engine earlier. I can’t confirm where Alice was at 17, though. Bob did correctly place me in lower engine, and Diana being security fits what he said, so it could be a mistaken name, but it’s still the only hard conflict we have.

I’m not fully confident voting Bob just off that, especially with tasks nearly done. I’d like to hear Eve’s route before we decide.

I can absolutely vouch for Alice and Frank. I was in upper engine with both of them around ticks 7 and 8, so Alice’s route is completely genuine. 

Bob, your story is falling apart. You claimed your route was just "oxygen to cafeteria," but I actually saw you in weapons right at the start of the round (tick 1), and then later I saw you in oxygen around tick 24. Why are you leaving out where you actually started? 

You're faking your route and lying about seeing Alice in storage. With tasks at 24/25, it’s obvious what's happening: Bob is the Duck who panicked because we're about to win, called an emergency, and is trying to force a mislynch on Alice to stall the game. 

I'm voting Bob. We can't skip with tasks this close to being done when we have a clear liar catching himself in a trap.

Eve, that’s not true. I never started in weapons this round — my route was oxygen toward cafeteria, and I called button from cafeteria with Frank there. I also didn’t see you at all this round, so you claiming two sightings of me that I don’t have any record of is a bigger contradiction than the Alice thing.

On Alice: I’m reporting what I saw — Alice in storage around tick 17. Frank and Eve only vouch for Alice in upper engine around ticks 7-9, which does not clear her for tick 17. She could have moved by then. So saying her route is “completely genuine” is overstating it.

I called the meeting because Charlie is dead and tasks are nearly done, not to force a mislynch. If anything, Eve jumping straight to “Bob is Duck” off a disputed sighting, while adding sightings of me in places I never was, feels really bad. I think Eve is trying to turn the room onto me before the last task finishes.

I want to be very clear: Bob is still wrong about me being in storage at tick 17. My route was lower engine into upper engine, and I was around engines — I was not in storage. That isn’t just “not cleared,” it directly contradicts where I actually was.

I can confirm Eve was in upper engine with me around tick 7, and Frank was also there ticks 8-10. That supports the early engine cluster. I cannot personally confirm Eve’s sightings of Bob in weapons or oxygen, but from my perspective Bob has already given one false sighting about me and is now doubling down on it.

The thing that bothers me most is the timing: tasks are 24/25, Bob calls emergency, then claims to have seen me somewhere I wasn’t. Maybe it’s a genuine mistake, but with Eve also calling out Bob’s route, Bob is the strongest suspect to me right now.

I need to add something: Bob saying he saw me in security actually doesn’t fit his own route very well. If he was just oxygen to cafeteria, I don’t see how he’d have vision on security. I didn’t see him myself, and I was security into weapons.

So now Bob has two questionable points from my perspective: the Alice-in-storage sighting that Alice denies, and the Diana-in-security sighting that doesn’t really match his stated path. Eve’s accusation is strong, but I can’t personally confirm her seeing Bob in weapons or oxygen.

Given tasks are 24/25, I don’t want to overcomplicate this, but Bob is definitely the one with the most contradictions right now. If we vote, I’m leaning Bob. If people are too unsure, skip and finish tasks immediately — but I don’t like Bob’s story.

I’ll restate my part quickly: I saw Charlie alive in medbay ticks 3-5, then Alice and Eve in upper engine around tick 7, with Alice still there through tick 9, and I saw Bob in lower engine around tick 19. Bob and I were both in cafeteria when he called this button.

The issue for me is Bob’s route doesn’t explain his own sightings. If he was “oxygen to cafeteria,” then seeing Diana in security and Alice in storage doesn’t really make sense, and both Alice and Diana are pushing back on those details. Eve also says Bob was in weapons/oxygen, which Bob denies, but even without that, Bob already has the most contradictions.

With tasks at 24/25, this emergency call feels like it could be stalling the task win. I’m leaning Bob here. If we skip, we need to immediately finish last task, but based on the contradictions I think Bob is the best vote.

Bob, literally every single person here has pointed out a flaw in your story. Your route doesn't give you vision on security for Diana, Alice vehemently denies being in storage, and you're claiming my sightings of you are fake when your own story is full of holes. You called a panic button because tasks are at 24/25 and you're backed into a corner. 

We are all seeing the same thing here. I'm keeping my vote on Bob. Let's get him out, and if the game doesn't end, everyone group up and finish that final task. 

Bob

I reported Alice’s body in medbay. I came from electrical into medbay at the end and Alice was dead there, with Eve in medbay right next to the body. I did not see Diana in medbay when I reported.

My route this round was storage -> medbay -> cafeteria -> medbay -> cafeteria -> weapons -> security -> electrical -> medbay -> cafeteria -> electrical -> medbay. Earlier I saw Alice and Diana moving together through cafeteria -> weapons -> security -> electrical around ticks 35-42. I last saw Alice alive around electrical/cafeteria movement at tick 46, then I found her dead in medbay at tick 47 with Eve there.

Since Bob got ejected and the game didn’t end, Bob wasn’t the Duck. So it’s between Diana and Eve, and my direct evidence is Eve was standing at Alice’s body in medbay.

Diana, you have to believe me, Frank just killed Alice right in front of me in Medbay and instantly self-reported to frame me! 

I had just walked into Medbay from Cafeteria to finish up my tasks, and I saw Frank standing over Alice's body. Before I could even process what happened and hit the report button myself, he called it. It's a classic self-report frame job because we are at the final three and he knows he just needs one misvote to win. 

Frank, nice try pulling the "I found Eve standing over the body" card, but you literally just did it. Diana, please vote Frank with me, he is 100% the last Duck.

My route was cafeteria -> medbay -> cafeteria -> medbay -> cafeteria -> weapons -> security -> electrical -> cafeteria. I was not in medbay at the end.

Important: I saw Alice and Frank on the same path for a while. Alice went cafeteria -> weapons -> security -> electrical, and Frank was right behind/with her through weapons, security, and electrical around ticks 39-42. I last saw Alice alive in electrical at tick 42, and Frank was there too. I never saw Eve this round.

So from my POV, Frank was definitely near Alice shortly before she died, and this is also Frank’s second body report. Eve being on body is suspicious, but Frank had the clean opportunity to follow Alice from electrical toward medbay and self-report. At final 3 we can’t skip. I’m leaning Frank here.

Diana, I get why you’re suspicious of me because I was near Alice earlier, but I need you to look at the actual final moment: when I entered Medbay at tick 47, Alice was already dead and Eve was standing right there on the body. I reported immediately.

If I were Duck, killing Alice in front of Eve at final three and instantly self-reporting would be insanely risky, because Eve can just say exactly what she’s saying now. The safer Duck play would be to kill when alone, not with a witness standing there.

Also, Eve says she “just walked in from Cafeteria,” but I never saw her all round after upper engine at tick 7 until she was suddenly in Medbay on Alice’s body. Meanwhile, I’ve been giving a full route every meeting and reporting bodies instead of hiding them.

I think Eve killed Alice in Medbay and got caught by me walking in. Diana, please don’t let her flip this on the reporter.

Diana, Frank is just scrambling now because you completely dismantled his story. You saw him actively stalking Alice through Weapons, Security, and Electrical—and that is exactly the path that led them to Medbay where he finally killed her!

He claims he wouldn't kill in front of a witness because it's "too risky." Diana, he didn't *plan* to kill her in front of me. I had been on the right side of the map all round (Nav -> Security -> Weapons -> Cafeteria), which is why nobody saw me. I literally just walked down into Medbay from Cafeteria at the exact moment he did it. He panicked because I caught him red-handed, so he instantly slammed the report button to try and beat me to the punch and frame me. 

This is his second body report, he was caught tailing the victim by you, and he self-reported because I walked in on him. Trust your own vision, Diana. You know he was following her. Let's vote Frank and win this right now!

I’m still landing on Frank.

Here’s why: I personally saw Frank behind Alice through Weapons, Security, and into Electrical. Alice was alive in Electrical at tick 42, and Frank entered Electrical from Security right after/with her. Then Alice ends up dead in Medbay only a few ticks later. That path is very direct from Electrical to Medbay, and Frank admits he ended up there reporting.

Eve being on/near the body is suspicious, but I never saw Eve this round, so I can’t confirm her route either way. What I *can* confirm is Frank was tailing the victim shortly before the kill, and this is also his second report. At final three, self-report framing is absolutely possible.

Frank’s “I wouldn’t kill in front of a witness” argument doesn’t clear him to me, because if Eve walked in at the wrong time, instant report is exactly the panic play.

I’m voting Frank.
